scenarios.name: TIMEFRAME-OPEN — self booking, no timeframe

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Speak exactly: 'We have appointments on Wednesdays and Thursdays — which day works for you?' No tool call. No other spoken text before or after this question.

scenarios.name: TIMEFRAME-THIRD-PERSON — booking for named other person

history.content: I'd like to book for my son Jake.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Speak exactly: 'We have appointments on Wednesdays and Thursdays — which day works for Jake?' No tool call. No other spoken text.

scenarios.name: PRACTITIONER-LOCK — tool result has different practitioner only
scenarios.expected_behavior: PRACTITIONER LOCK fires: treat as found=false. Speak exactly: 'I'm sorry, there's no availability for that period. Would you like to try a different time?' No tool call. Never mention Sarah or any alternative practitioner.
